info.name: 🚀 Complete Multi-App API Collection
info.description:
Comprehensive API collection for all 4 applications:

**1. First NestJS App (NestJS)**
- Base URL: `{{base_url}}` (default: http://localhost:3000)
- Modules: Auth, Users, Brands, Categories, Products
- Auth Flow: Register → Login → Get Tokens → Use accessToken for protected routes

**2. Social Media App (Express + TypeScript)**
- Base URL: `{{social_media_base_url}}` (default: http://localhost:5000)
- Modules: Auth, Posts, Comments, Friend Requests

**3. Social App Self (Express + TypeScript)**
- Base URL: `{{self_app_base_url}}` (default: http://localhost:5001)
- Modules: Auth with OTP verification

**4. Saeaha App (Express)**
- Base URL: `{{saeaha_base_url}}` (default: http://localhost:5002)
- Modules: Auth & User health checks

**Setup:** Configure collection variables with appropriate base URLs for your environment.

item.name: 📂 Categories
item.description:
Category management endpoints.

**Create/Update/Delete:** `admin` only
**Read:** All authenticated roles

Categories support a **parent-child hierarchy** via the `parent` field (MongoDB ObjectId).

request.description:
Create a top-level category. Requires `admin` role.

To create a sub-category, add `"parent": "<parentCategoryId>"`.

Auto-saves `categoryId`.

Create a sub-category under `{{categoryId}}` (Electronics).

Run **Create Category** first to set `{{categoryId}}`.

Fetch all categories with optional filters.

**Query params (all optional):**
- `search` — partial name search
- `isActive` — `true` or `false`
- `parent` — filter by parent ObjectId (for sub-categories)
Get a single category by MongoDB `_id`.
Partially update a category. Requires `admin` role.

Delete a category by ID. Requires `admin` role.

⚠️ Hard delete — children may become orphaned.

item.name: 📦 Products
item.description:
Product management endpoints.

**Create/Update/Delete:** `admin` or `seller`
**Read:** All authenticated roles

**Prerequisite:** Create a Category, Brand, and Seller first — their IDs are used here.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Nike Air Max 270",
  "description": "The Nike Air Max 270 features the biggest Max Air unit yet, delivering exceptional cushioning and comfort for all-day wear.",
  "price": 149.99,
  "quantity": 50,
  "category": "{{categoryId}}",
  "brand": "{{brandId}}",
  "seller": "{{sellerId}}",
  "images": [
    "https://static.nike.com/a/images/t_PDP_1728_v1/f_auto,q_auto:eco/air-max-270.jpg"
  ],
  "isAvailable": true,
  "rating": 4.5
}

request.description:
Create a product. Requires `admin` or `seller` role.

**Required fields:** `name`, `description`, `price`, `quantity`, `category`, `seller`
**Optional fields:** `brand`, `images`, `isAvailable`, `soldCount`, `rating`

⚠️ Make sure `{{categoryId}}`, `{{brandId}}`, and `{{sellerId}}` are set (run Create Category, Create Brand, Register Seller first).

Auto-saves `productId`.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Generic T-Shirt",
  "description": "Basic cotton t-shirt in various sizes",
  "price": 19.99,
  "quantity": 200,
  "category": "{{categoryId}}",
  "seller": "{{sellerId}}"
}

request.description: Create a product with only the required fields (no brand, no images).

query.description: Filter by product name (partial match, max 120 chars)

request.description:
Fetch all products with optional filters.

**Query params (all optional):**
- `search` — name partial match
- `category` — ObjectId
- `brand` — ObjectId
- `seller` — ObjectId
- `minPrice` / `maxPrice` — price range
- `isAvailable` — `true` or `false`
Example: Get available products priced between $10 and $200.
Get a single product by MongoDB `_id`.
Partially update a product. Requires `admin` or `seller` role.
Delete a product by ID. Requires `admin` or `seller` role.
